column1: # citation-checks.tsv -- the data table verify-citations.py reads, kept apart
# from the script so a check is added without touching code.
#   label   -- the canonical-section name reported in the STATUS lines.
#   pattern -- the literal string each site must contain (grep -F / -SimpleMatch).
#   site*   -- one or more repo-relative file paths; each must contain at
#              least one literal occurrence of pattern. Any number of sites
# Comment lines start with '#'; blank lines are ignored. Both loaders skip
# them and append every other line to CHECKS unchanged.
# Each entry typically lists its own owner file as a site (it contains the
# heading itself). Site lists are grep-verified against the repo -- add a
# site only when the file holds a live reference to the section's literal
# Row ORDER matters only for output ordering, not correctness: the sh
# script's stdout must stay byte-identical to what it printed before this
# table existed, so do not reorder existing rows -- append new ones at the
# end. LF line endings, no BOM (the repo's .gitattributes forces eol=lf).
